auth.description: Salesforce OAuth2 access token sent as a bearer; already minted, supplied through the environment
auth.name: salesforce.access_token
auth.subject: unstated

config.help: The subdomain of your org's My Domain URL — if you log in at acme.my.salesforce.com, this is acme. Find it under Setup → Company Settings → My Domain, or read it off the instance_url your org's login flow returns
config.label: Salesforce My Domain name
config.name: instance

config.help: An OAuth2 access token for this org — minted by Salesforce's own login flow, or by a Connected App's client-credentials or JWT-bearer flow, and pasted here already-minted. It is short-lived; a call that starts failing with 401 usually means this needs refreshing
config.label: Access token
config.name: access_token

description: Salesforce REST API: read the authenticated identity, read/create/update an SObject record, and describe an SObject's schema

operations.description: Get the authenticated user and org for the current access token — the identity check for a settings page's Test Connection button. Takes no parameters

organization_id.description: The 18-character id of the org the token authenticates against

preferred_username.description: Usually the Salesforce username, which is email-shaped but is not necessarily a deliverable address

user_id.description: The 18-character id of the authenticated user

user_type.description: e.g. STANDARD for a full internal user; a Community/Experience Cloud or partner user carries a different value here

operations.description: Read one SObject record by id. Returns every field of the record; narrowing to a subset needs the fields query parameter, which this connector cannot encode safely (see the provider file's header) so it is not offered

params.description: The SObject's API name, e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, or a custom object ending in __c
params.name: sobject_type

params.description: The record's Salesforce id, 15 characters (case-sensitive) or 18 (case-insensitive)
params.name: id

response_schema.description: Every member besides `attributes` is one of the SObject's own fields — standard and custom — and the set is per-object and per-org. Read it with `salesforce-sobject-describe` rather than assuming a fixed shape

type.description: The SObject API name this record is

operations.description: Create one SObject record. Which fields are required depends on the SObject type and the org's own validation rules and page layouts — check with salesforce-sobject-describe first

params.description: The SObject's API name, e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, or a custom object ending in __c
params.name: sobject_type

schema.description: The new record's field values as a JSON object, e.g. {"Name": "Acme", "Industry": "Technology"}. Which fields exist and which are required depends on the SObject type and the org's schema

errors.description: Empty on success. Populated on a partial failure such as a validation rule, each entry carrying statusCode, message and the fields it names

operations.description: Update one or more fields on an existing SObject record. Only the supplied fields change; fields left out are untouched. Answers 204 with no body on success

params.description: The SObject's API name, e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, or a custom object ending in __c
params.name: sobject_type

params.description: The record's Salesforce id, 15 characters (case-sensitive) or 18 (case-insensitive)
params.name: id

schema.description: The fields to change, as a JSON object, e.g. {"Industry": "Technology"}. Fields not present are left untouched; which fields exist depends on the SObject type and the org's schema

operations.description: Describe an SObject's schema: its label, whether it is custom, its create/update/delete/query permissions, and every field's name, type and constraints. The reference for what salesforce-record-create and salesforce-record-update may send

params.description: The SObject's API name, e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, or a custom object ending in __c
params.name: sobject_type

fields.description: Every field's own metadata, standard and custom

picklistValues.description: Present only on a picklist field: each entry carries value, label, active and defaultValue

type.description: Salesforce's field type, e.g. string, boolean, reference, picklist, currency — not a JSON Schema type

keyPrefix.description: The 3-character prefix embedded in every record id of this type; null for objects with none
